summary.text: David Biele is a Democratic member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives who has represented the 4th Suffolk District since January 2019 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Biele took office on January 2, 2019, and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.

For the 2025-2026 session, he was assigned to the House Ways and Means Committee, the joint committees on Aging and Independence, Emergency Preparedness and Management, and Ways and Means, and served as vice chair of the Financial Services Joint Committee.
